# Project Bergen — a seam layer for Macari Vineyards

**Evals:** see [`evals/STATUS.md`](evals/STATUS.md) — regenerated by every `make eval`.

## The thesis (the ≤150-word version)

Macari's platforms are fine. Commerce7 runs the club, Block55 runs
reservations, the POS rings sales. What no platform owns is the **seams
between them**: the cancellation that was requested but processed nowhere
until it became a five-call TripAdvisor complaint; the $30–60K wedding
inquiry aging in a shared inbox; the elite press coverage nobody reconciles
with mixed guest reviews; the website quoting $150 *and* $185 for the same
Private Suite. Project Bergen is that seam layer: four small, deterministic
pipelines that watch the gaps, draft the follow-through, and **refuse to
act without a human**. Every fact in every draft traces to one ground-truth
file, enforced by a code-level validator — not a prompt. Nothing sends,
ever: approving a draft writes a file. The send function does not exist.

## Run it

```bash
pip install pyyaml anthropic     # anthropic optional — see note below
make eval                        # the five gates (the system is graded, not vibed)
make demo                        # full flow on fixtures, < 2 min
```

With `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` set, classification runs on haiku and drafting on
sonnet (models in `config.yaml`). Without a key, deterministic rule/template
fallbacks run the identical pipelines — same gates, same artifacts, zero
network. Every artifact is labeled with the mode that produced it.

## The four components

| # | Component | Seam it covers | Artifact |
|---|-----------|----------------|----------|
| 1 | `watcher/` | press vs. guest reality, report-by-exception | `out/digest_YYYY-MM-DD.html` |
| 2 | `responder/` | events@ response speed (<60s to draft) | approval queue |
| 3 | `triage/` | club exceptions that refuse to be forgotten | `out/triage_log.jsonl` |
| 4 | `audit/` | the website contradicting itself | `out/surface_audit.md` |

Shared: `approval/` (the human gate — **in code, not prompts**),
`ground_truth/packages.yaml` (single source of truth),
`common/validator.py` (hard gate: an unsupported price/capacity/date fails
the build).

## Guardrails

Read-only against the public web (robots.txt honored, rate-limited, cached,
identifiable UA). All member and inquiry data is synthetic and labeled so in
every fixture. Estimated figures are labeled with their derivation in
`packages.yaml`. No open-ended agent loops — every component is a fixed
pipeline with at most two LLM calls, chained in code.

Demo choreography: [`DEMO_SCRIPT.md`](DEMO_SCRIPT.md).
